preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: Length of each array N is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A_i <= 10**9 for A_i in As)
preconditions.description: Each element A_i in the array is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The total sum of Ns across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output[i], str) for i in range(T))
all(output[i] == '-1' or (len(output[i].split()) == Ns[i] and all(int(x) in As[i] for x in output[i].split())) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each output is either '-1' or a permutation of the input array.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(all(A[j] >= A[k] for k in range(j, j+3)) or all(A[j] <= A[k] for k in range(j, j+3)) for j in range(len(A)-2)) for A in interesting_arrays)
postconditions.description: No subarray of length greater than 2 is non-increasing or non-decreasing.
